competences.description: Attacks the enemy 2 times and increases the chances of the enemy to land a Glancing Hit for 2 turns with a 30% chance on each strike.

effets.description: The chance of landing a glancing hit will be increased by 50%. Glancing Hits will decrease the damage by 30% and if the attacker has attribute disadvantage, damage will be decreased additionally by 16%.

competences.description: Instantly readies all skills of an ally except yourself. [Ventilate] will not be affected by other cooldown reduction or increasing skills.

effets.description: Reduces cool down counter of skills by 1 or more

competences.description: Calls upon the power of light to inflict damage ignoring enemy's defense. Gains 1 turn of invincibility if the enemy dies.

effets.description: Attack will ignore the target's defense.
The target will be invincible and receive no damage.
